browse.title: Shbeik Lbeik
browse.subtitle: Community wishes — what people hope to find
browse.introTitle: What is Shbeik Lbeik, and how does it work?
browse.intro: Write what you wish you could find but cannot — a workshop, course, event, anything. Anyone can endorse a wish once, and organizations read this board while planning upcoming programs. The most-endorsed wishes reach them first.
browse.supportersDescription: Names are hidden on the card so endorsement stays focused on the idea, not who endorsed it.
browse.supportersDescriptionMine: Names are hidden on the card so endorsement stays focused on the idea, not who endorsed it.
browse.emptyDescription: Clear the filter or add a new wish.
browse.lockedNote: Editing and deletion close after the first endorsement — endorsement applies to the wording people saw. You can withdraw it instead.
browse.editableNote: Nobody has endorsed it yet — you can edit or delete it.
browse.newWishTitle: Have a wish that is not here?
browse.newWishDescription: Search first — if a similar wish exists, endorsing it is stronger than adding a duplicate.
browse.orgViewDescription: When an organization plans a workshop or new program, it checks here first to see what people want. Your endorsement is not just a number — it helps decide what gets made next season.

myWishes.title: Shbeik Lbeik
myWishes.subtitle: My wishes · what you proposed or endorsed

addWish.searchDescription: If a similar wish already exists, endorsing it is stronger than adding a duplicate because organizations see one large number rather than two small ones.
addWish.searchPlaceholder: Type what you want to find — e.g. photography workshop
addWish.noSearchResults: No similar wish — continue and add it.
addWish.continueToWish: I cannot find it — add my wish
addWish.detailsDescription: Describe what you wish you could find but cannot. Organizations read this board while planning, so clarity makes it easier for someone to deliver it.
addWish.editDescription: Revise the wording before anyone endorses the wish.
addWish.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Evening acting workshop after work
addWish.categoryHint: One or two words describing the field — shown as a tag on the wish card.
addWish.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe it as you imagine it — duration, level, and who it is for.
addWish.impactLabel: Why can you not find it?
addWish.impactPlaceholder: What did you find when you searched before, and what was missing?
addWish.impactHint: Optional — but it helps an organization understand the gap and create something genuinely different.
addWish.publicNameTitle: Your wish will show your name.
addWish.publicNameDescription: Anyone can endorse it once, and you can edit or remove it while it has no endorsements.
addWish.successDescription: It now appears in Shbeik Lbeik and anyone can endorse it. The more support it gets, the higher it appears on the board organizations read.
addWish.editSuccessDescription: Your changes were saved and the updated wording now appears in Shbeik Lbeik.
addWish.titleRequired: Write the wish in one line
addWish.titleMin: The wish title must be at least 3 characters
addWish.descriptionMin: Description must be at least 10 characters
addWish.impactMin: The explanation must be at least 10 characters

mobilePhotography.title: Mobile photography workshop for beginners
mobilePhotography.description: I want a workshop that teaches me to take good photos with my phone — no cameras or equipment, just the phone.

oudCourse.title: Oud from scratch
oudCourse.description: Nobody teaches oud to adult beginners. Courses are either for children or people who already know the basics.

personalArchives.title: Workshops on archiving personal collections
personalArchives.description: I have family photos, tapes, and papers and do not know how to preserve them. I need someone to teach me the basics.

readingGroup.title: Reading and literary criticism group
readingGroup.description: A group that meets every two weeks to read and discuss a book — not a lecture, but people talking together.

eveningActing.title: Evening acting workshop
eveningActing.description: An acting workshop after work on weekdays, for people who work mornings and want to try acting.

outdoorMusic.title: Outdoor music nights
outdoorMusic.description: Music nights in gardens or on rooftops — not closed halls with expensive tickets.

documentaryPhotography.title: Documentary photography course for beginners
documentaryPhotography.description: A course on documentary photography basics — story, light, and editing, without expensive equipment.
